title: A Lianga Diary: Kamayo
text: October 4, 2011 - Much of the old Kamayo that I use to know as a child is already gone or evolving. The sometimes loud and jarring yet often lilting, musical intonation I was used to as a child I seldom hear today except when talking with the older generation in the remote barrios and villages around Lianga and San Agustin towns.
